name: r6g_StatusLoadTextures
notes: load the big textures and build the sprites of the current status-screen texture set; the original scales the record index once with shl 2 and reads the three layer bytes with byte displacements where modern cl uses scaled addressing per load

name: r6g_TextDrawOutline
notes: draw a text box four times offset by d diagonally as an outline of the given alpha and restore its position/colours; regargs: t=EAX alpha=ESI ctx=EBX (d on the stack); calls 0x000768D0 with EDI=t

name: r6g_PlayerSetAnimBank
notes: switch the player's animation bank: detach and rebuild the model node with its animation fields cleared and put them back

name: r6g_PlayerActionInput
notes: pick the next player action state from the buttons pressed and the stick direction; modern cl materialises the case value 5 as lea [dir+2] right after testing dir == 3 (constant selection idiom; same value); calls 0x000CD300 with EAX=p

name: r6g_ReturnToTitle
notes: leave the game and run the title page; modern cl merges the four byte stores at 0x00428F80 into one dword store (0x104) and pushes the float argument 8.0 from .rdata instead of as an immediate

name: r6g_ObjModelsCreate
notes: create the 18-entry model list of a 3D object; apply its light; set slot sizes and install the per-slot draw hooks

name: r6g_PresentsLoad
notes: load the twelve present model records (pack list; kind 13; index) and tail-call 0x000C87B0

name: r6g_AttackHitSlots
notes: apply an attack to every active entity slot then re-test the targets already hit (push back; hit effect for types 8/10/11); the original addresses the hit slot from o+0x6A8 (+0x204/+0x404) where modern cl uses the absolute field offset 0x8AC; pointer loop end compared signed by the original and unsigned by modern cl

name: r6g_AttackHitObjects
notes: apply an attack to every object of the object iterator then re-test the targets already hit (0x000C64D0 on a hit; hit effect for types 10/11 and 0x000CA400 for type 14 on a miss); the original addresses the hit slot from o+0x6A8 (+0x204/+0x404) where modern cl uses the absolute field offset 0x8AC

name: r6g_EffDestroy
notes: destroy an effect object: detach its part; release node/buffers/textures/resources; unlink it from its owner list and free it

name: r6g_EvtWaitBits
notes: event handler: wait for event bit 0xCD (step 10) or 0x11B (step 11; sets 0xCD) then hide the slot-0 actor and set the camera mode; message 0 reset / 1 start / 3 stop

name: r6g_MenuLoadImages
notes: decode the images of menu page 0..3 into the work block; pages 1..3 flip the double-buffer half and decode the selected item images into it

name: r6g_MenuBuildSprites
notes: build the textures and sprites of the selected menu page (0..3) from the decoded images; sprites 1/3/5 are struct copies of 0/2/4

name: r6g_PauseLoadImages
notes: decode the images of pause page 0..5 into the work block (0x00053E20 for images loaded by name; 0x00053ED0 for the others)

name: r6g_ChapterBuildSprites
notes: build the textures and sprites of chapter screen page 0..2; page 1 makes one texture per entry of the current chapter (count per video mode)

name: r6g_ObjLoadModel
notes: load the model of a 3D object from a pack: create its six boxes; read the model data (tag 0x4C474240 or older format) with texture group 0x1000; build each box collision data in a scratch buffer and shrink it

name: r6g_EvtGroupsByBit
notes: event handler: unless event bit 0xF3 is set (then finish) switch groups 0x10..0x17 on or off every frame by event bit 0xBF; message 0 reset / 1 start / 3 stop

name: r6g_EvtCameraPan
notes: event script: set bit 0xDD; wait; camera move 1 and wait; wait two seconds (fps*2 truncated inline); camera move 3 and wait; clear bit 0xDD; modern cl emits the multiply by 2.0 as an add (x+x) so the .rdata constant 2.0 is not referenced (same value)

name: r6g_EntitiesRelease
notes: release every active entity slot (calls 0x000A4DE0 with EAX=slot) stepping 0x000A3810 per slot; detach the paired model records (2 in mode 12 else 16) and free both model tables; clear the entity id table; pointer loop end compared signed by the original and unsigned by modern cl

name: r6g_TxaLoad
notes: parse a text table (eight columns; third ignored; last read with %f) into a new @TXA record; 0 when no line has a token; modern cl merges the four tag byte stores (@ T X A at +0..+3) into one dword store 0x41585440

name: r6g_MovieScreenStep
notes: one step of the movie screen: wait out a playing movie and restore the display; else restart the screen with the selected entry sprite animations (entry 1 may leave instead) or close it (0/4)
